definitions.short: Ithiel , the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person
definitions.full: H384. Ithiel אִרתִיאֵל אִיתַי, see אֵת with . אִיתָמָר see אִי below I. אוה . אֵתָן אֵיתָן, see יתן . אִיתִיאֵל 1 Prov 30:1 (twice in verse) וְאֻכָֽל׃ לְאִיתִיאֵל לְאִיתִיאֵל הַגֶּבֶר נְאֻם , in MT. proper name, masculine (probably with me is God: see Ol § 82 c ) usually taken as name of a son or pupil of Agur; but most moderns read וֵָאכֶל׃ אֵל לָאִיתִי אֵל לָאִיתִי I have wearied myself (see לָאָה ), O God, I have wearied myself, O God, and am consumed . 2 a Benjamite Neh 11:7 .
